tagline: Check a rental listing for scam risk before you pay.
footer: RentSafe MY · Prototype · Risk scoring is advisory only — always verify in person.

landing.title: Check a rental listing before you pay.
landing.lead: Many scams start on Facebook or Mudah, then pull you into a private WhatsApp chat and rush you for a deposit. Paste the listing — we'll score the risk in seconds.
landing.step1Desc: Drop in the listing text, or a WhatsApp / Mudah screenshot.
landing.step2Desc: Text, web complaints and the asking price — all checked at once.
landing.step3Desc: A clear 0–100 score with plain-language advice on what to do.

form.title: Analyse a listing
form.subtitle: Tampal teks iklan atau mesej WhatsApp. The more detail, the better the score.
form.textLabel: Paste the listing text (or the WhatsApp message)
form.placeholder: e.g. Fully furnished studio near KLCC, RM750/month, wifi included, pls whatsapp fast deal...
form.textIgnored: Your screenshots will be analysed — the pasted text is not used while screenshots are attached.
form.uploadTitle: Or upload a WhatsApp / listing screenshot
form.uploadHint: OCR runs behind the scenes — drag & drop or browse
form.uploadOrder: Pages are read in this order. Put them in chat order, oldest first — the file names don't decide it.
form.tooMany: Up to 20 screenshots at a time.
form.noIdentity: Without a phone number or full name we can't search for scam reports online, so that check is left out of the score.
form.areaPick: Pick an area from the list — the price check only knows those areas.
form.areaListUnavailable: The area list couldn't be loaded; type the area name.
form.fillSample: Fill with the KLCC sample listing
form.textTooShort: Paste a few lines of the conversation (at least 20 characters), or upload screenshots.
form.errorNetwork: Can't reach the RentSafe server. Check that the backend is running, then try again.
form.errorGeneric: Something went wrong while analysing. Please try again.

analysing.title: Analysing the listing…
analysing.subtitle: Running three checks in parallel. Sekejap ya.

headline.LOW: Lower risk — but not proof it's safe.
headline.HIGH: Strong warning signs — be very careful.
headline.CRITICAL: Do not pay any deposit for this listing.
headline.UNKNOWN: We can't score this listing yet.

advice.LOW: Proceed with standard caution, and verify the agent's details directly before paying.
advice.MODERATE: Verify the REN number, ask for an official receipt and view the unit before paying.
advice.HIGH: Get a second opinion, and do not pay without viewing the unit.
advice.CRITICAL: Avoid this listing and do not transfer any money.

explain.title: What this means
explain.aiNote: Written by AI from the result above, after the score was calculated. It cannot change the score.

advice.LOW: No strong scam signals were found, but always verify the agent directly before paying anything.
advice.MODERATE: Verify the agent's REN number, ask for an official receipt and view the unit before paying.
advice.HIGH: Don't pay anything before viewing the unit in person, and get a second opinion.
advice.CRITICAL: Please don't transfer any deposit or booking fee — and don't pay before viewing the unit in person.

guide.title: User Guide
guide.step2: Paste your WhatsApp conversation with the suspected agent or landlord. Our NLP model understands Manglish shortforms (e.g., 'byr dlu', 'tgk').
guide.step3: Enter the agent's phone number and name. We will cross-reference this with public scam reports.
guide.step4: Enter the listed price, area, and property type to check for extreme underpricing anomalies.
guide.step5: Click 'Analyse' and review the risk score.
guide.lowText: Proceed with standard caution. Verify agent details directly.
guide.moderateText: Multiple indicators present. Verify REN number, request official receipt, view before paying.
guide.highText: Strong warning signs. Get second opinion, do not pay without viewing.
guide.criticalText: Avoid this listing. Do not transfer any money. Report to NSRC: 997.

about.title: About RentSafe MY
about.body: RentSafe MY combines Malaysian NLP scam detection, online complaint search, and price-anomaly checking into a single explainable risk score. It is a Final Year Project and not a substitute for your own due diligence.
